lines.zh: 活石做成的腿，走起来发响。
lines.en: Legs of living stone, and they sound as they go.
As I walk, grit falls from my joints.
I walk along the crystal's rim.

lines.zh: 身上有小块的石头在动。
lines.en: Small stones shift on my body.

lines.zh: 我一摇一摆地走过沙地。
lines.en: I rock my way across the sand.
Each step looks ready to come apart.

lines.zh: 我踩到的小石子会嵌进脚里。
lines.en: Pebbles stick into my feet.

lines.zh: 我转过身，碎石落在后面。
lines.en: I turn, and gravel falls behind.

lines.zh: 我沿着晶体绕了大半圈。
lines.en: I circle most of the way around the crystal.
My shadow is grey.
I go slowly. Stone is heavy.
I stop beside my companions.

lines.zh: 我的背上驮着一块小石头。
lines.en: A small stone rides on my back.

lines.zh: 我不时停下来，等后面的。
lines.en: Now and then I stop for the ones behind.
We gather in a half circle.
I go around my companions to the head of the line.
My knees click with every step.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的石头在响。
lines.en: Standing, the stones of me click.
I face a large crystal.
My outline resembles an animal.
I am slowly sinking into the sand.

lines.zh: 有一块石头从我腿上掉了。
lines.en: A stone fell off my leg.
I tilt my head, stiffly.

lines.zh: 晶体表面映着我的样子。
lines.en: The crystal reflects what I am.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把自己拼回去。
lines.en: I fit myself back together, bit by bit.
I listen to something inside the crystal.
There are gaps in my body.
Sand blows over my feet.
I have not moved in a long while.
I wait for the others to return.
This heap of stones is alive.
My eyes are two dark points.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，身上的石块挪动。
lines.en: I raise my head; my stones shift.
You stepped on the crystal.
We eat stone around here.

lines.zh: 活石做的手脚，慢慢转过来。
lines.en: Limbs of living stone turn slowly toward you.
Eight of us in this group.
Your shadow covers the crystal.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来的，你能捡。
lines.en: You may pick up what falls off me.
We will not strike first.
Stand outside the crystal.
You are much softer than we are.

lines.zh: 你看着我们，很不自在吧。
lines.en: Watching us makes you uneasy, does it not?
My mouth is in a stone seam.

lines.zh: 我肩上的石片被打掉了。
lines.en: A stone flake knocked off my shoulder.
I turned half a beat late.
Half a step back, with a crunch.
I reassemble myself a little.
Grit scatters on the ground.
My movements have stiffened.
I am still standing firm.
Our group has drawn back.
The stone cannot take another blow.
Is that a stone?
Put it beside the crystal.
We are not picky eaters.
This has a faint sweetness.
That piece in your hand. For me.
I might accept it.
Our group needs a lot.
Step back, then we come.
This piece can be chewed.

lines.zh: 这块里有一点别的颜色。
lines.en: There is a streak of another color in this one.
Just leave it on the crystal.
We never eat meat.
This sand is all grit and chips.
Carry over a few more.

lines.zh: 我觉得那块石头比别的软。
lines.en: That stone feels softer than the rest.
A few pieces fell off me.
Back off. I might come apart.
You stepped on my foot stone.
That bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，本来就挤。
lines.en: We are crowded together as it is.
I shift aside, bit by bit.
You touched living stone.
Another piece fell from me.
Go around our group.
This body of mine is living stone.
My stones are pressed against you.
We are assembled, not born.
They grow in the crystal.
Our group is large enough.
That is not something we do.
Stone on stone shatters.
Gathering in a circle is enough.

lines.zh: 我连完整的身体都没有。
lines.en: I do not even have a whole body.

lines.zh: 我们只和晶体待在一起。
lines.en: We keep to the crystals.
We go back to eating stone.

lines.zh: 地上有一块同类的碎片。
lines.en: A fragment of kin on the ground.
I press it onto my body.
This piece fits.
I lift a heavy stone.
I tuck the grit into a seam.
This piece cannot be eaten.
I carry it back beside the crystal.
A few grains fell from my hand.
Do not take it. Mine.
You crowded the crystal.
Our whole group has stopped.
The stones on me are clicking.
We have closed around you.
You are blocking the crystal's light.
We will not strike, but we will not yield.
Stones everywhere at your feet.
The circle has tightened.
Get ten steps back.
Gravel crunches underfoot.

lines.zh: 我不急，石头有的是时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. Stone has time.
One step back and the circle tightens.
That crystal is glowing.
We ring you with loose stones.
All eight of us are watching you.
Stop right here.

lines.zh: 活石在追你，晶体记得你的脚步。
lines.en: Living stone follows — the crystal remembers your steps.
I raise an arm of stone.
Stone strikes with a dull thud.
Fragments fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 我推你，用的是整块肩石。
lines.en: I shove with a whole shoulder stone.
Slow, but heavy.

lines.zh: 我的石手抓住你的衣角。
lines.en: My stone hand grips your hem.
I pound the ground once.
You retreat. I stop.

lines.zh: 晶体底下多了几块石头。
lines.en: A few stones appear under the crystal.
We rise, one after another.
The stones assemble into a shape.

lines.zh: 晶体边上，我们一只只站起。
lines.en: By the crystal, we rise one by one.
We form a ring. Eight of us.

lines.zh: 晶体把光照在我们身上。
lines.en: The crystal shines on us.
I drop a piece and pick it up again.
We have trodden the sand flat.
I stand on the outside of the group.
I begin looking for stone to eat.
Fire makes the stone crack faster.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，散成几块。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and break into pieces.
Water forces into my stone seams.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震得散了一半。
lines.en: The blast scatters half of me.
An arrow is stuck in my stone.

lines.zh: 这光让石头里的东西动了。
lines.en: This light stirs something in the stone.

lines.zh: 没有石头可吃，我变轻了。
lines.en: No stone to eat. I grow lighter.
Current runs through my seams and lights me.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，石头也留不住。
lines.en: No ground below. Even stone cannot stay.
